items.name: Logo-first cold open
items.why_bad: Wastes the 0–1s thumb-stop window on identity the viewer doesn’t care about yet.
items.fix: Open on problem, confession, transformation, or trend format; brand after second 8–12.

items.name: Feature laundry list
items.why_bad: No single job; nothing memorable; sounds like a brochure.
items.fix: One job per ad. Features become proof of the mechanism, not the headline.

items.name: Obviously fake UGC
items.why_bad: Studio lighting + teleprompter cadence + stock smile triggers distrust.
items.fix: Real handheld, real environment, imperfect takes, or lean into polished cinematic honestly.

items.name: Multiple CTAs
items.why_bad: Splits action; muddies attribution; lowers conversion.
items.fix: One primary CTA per cut; variants live in the A/B matrix, not the same video.

items.name: Invented testimonials or metrics
items.why_bad: Legal and trust risk; models hallucinate social proof easily.
items.fix: Only use reviews, numbers, and awards the user provides. Otherwise use pattern-level proof structure with placeholders.

items.name: Muted-illegible text
items.why_bad: Most feed views start muted; tiny captions = dead ad.
items.fix: Assume muted. Hook must read as text or work as pure visual.

items.name: Promise mismatch on landing
items.why_bad: Kills conversion even if CTR is strong.
items.fix: Mirror hook language above the fold; same offer, same SKU, same geo.

items.name: Forced trend with no offer map
items.fix: Punchline must equal product truth, or skip the trend.
